nodes.label: armors.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all armor pieces. Each entry contains name, slot (head/chest/legs), stats (physicalDefense, magicDefense, etc.), optional perk references, set bonuses, and rarity information.

nodes.label: blades.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all blade weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base damage values, scaling stats, element types, attack speed modifiers, and weapon-type classification.

nodes.label: enchantments.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all enchantments. Each entry contains name, category (refined/strengthened/dexterous/burning/etc.), stat bonuses, and slot compatibility.

nodes.label: essences.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all essence weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base stats, element modifiers, and weapon-type restrictions.

nodes.label: gloves.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all glove weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base stats, and scaling information.

nodes.label: guilds.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all guilds. Each entry contains name, guild ranks with stat bonuses, perk references, and description. Used to populate the guild selector in the character configuration.

nodes.label: handles.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all handle weapon parts. Each entry contains name, base damage, scaling stats, weapon-type modifiers, and attack properties.

nodes.label: perks.json
nodes.description: Comprehensive static game data defining all perks. Massive dataset (3688 lines) containing every perk's name, description, tags (combat/support/status), stat bonuses, damage formulas, cooldown references, and scaling parameters. Core reference for the entire damage calculation engine.

nodes.label: races.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all 11 playable races. Each entry contains name, passive abilities, stat modifiers (HP, speed, elemental resistances), and racial perk references.

nodes.label: rings.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all ring accessories. Each entry contains name, stat bonuses, perk slots, and rarity information.

nodes.label: runes.json
nodes.description: Static game data defining all runes. Each entry contains name, activation conditions, stat bonuses, damage effects, and cooldown properties.
